verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim's own GitHub feature list includes exporting robots and environments to non-USD formats, and its native scene format is OpenUSD, an open format. Isaac Lab can also package policies into portable deployment bundles. These cover key asset types, but there is no documented complete-data export or exit path. Missing for 10: a documented export of all user data (generated datasets, configs, trained artifacts) in named open formats, explicit migration or offboarding guidance, and independent hands-on confirmation that exports round-trip correctly.
